Buza imodeli ye-AI oyimisile kukhibhodi
Lesi siphazamisi singathumela umbhalo kumodeli ye-AI oyilungisile. Uma leyo modeli isebenza ku-inthanethi, umbhalo ushiya ifoni yakho futhi nemigomo yomphakeli iyasebenza.
Funda ikhalenda lakho bese wengeza imicimbi kulo
Le plugin ingafunda imicimbi ekamakhalenda efoni yakho ngenkathi iphaneli yayo ivulekile, futhi ingangeza imicimbi emisha kuyo.
Funda ibhodi lokunamathisela, uma uthepha okuthile kuphaneli yalo
Leli pulagi lingafunda okukopshile, njalo uma uthepha okuthile kuphaneli yalo. Alikaze libone izicucu eziphawulwe njengeziyimfihlo.
Kopisha umbhalo ebhodini lokunamathisela
Setha ama-alamu nezikhathi eWashi lekhibhodi
Le plugin ingafunda umbhalo owunika yona bese iwuthumela kumodeli yakho ye-AI.
Le plugin ingafunda umbhalo noma amafayela owanikayo bese iwathumela ku-%1$s.
Dlidliza, vula isibane futhi ufunde umbhalo ngokuzwakalayo
Funda umbhalo osezungeze ikhesa nombhalo owukhethile, uma uthepha okuthile kuphaneli yayo
Le plugin ingafunda okubhalayo kuhlelo lokusebenza olubhala kulo, isikhathi ngasinye lapho uthepha okuthile kuphaneli yalo. Ayisoze yakwazi ezindaweni zamaphasiwedi noma ku-incognito.
Thayipha, shintsha futhi ususe umbhalo ngenkathi uthayipha enkundleni
Vula amafayela owakhethayo nezithombe ozithathayo, futhi ulondoloze amafayela lapho ukhetha khona
Le plugi ingafunda yonke ifayela oyikhethayo nesithombe osithathayo, futhi ingacela ukulondoloza amafayela.
Thola lapho ucingo lwakho lukhona
Lesi siphazamisi singathola ukuthi ifoni yakho ikuphi ngenkathi iphanele yayo ivuliwe.
Xhuma ku-inthanethi, kumawebhusayithi abhalwe yiyo
Finyelela iseva oyithayiphayo kuzilungiselelo zayo kunethiwekhi yakho yasekhaya

Le plugin ingaxhuma kuseva oyithayipha kuzilungiselelo zayo lapho leyo seva isenethiwekhi yakho yendawo: ikheli elifana no-192.168.1.20, igama elinegama elilodwa, noma igama eliphelela ku-.local, .lan noma .home.arpa. Ingasebenzisa i-http evamile lapho, futhi ku-http evamile noma ubani kuleyo nethiwekhi angafunda okuthunyelwa, okuhlanganisa namagama-mfihlo namathokheni.
Lesi siphazamisi singathumela idatha kumawebhusayithi esiwabhale ohlwini, futhi lawo mawebhusayithi angabona ikheli lakho le-IP. Noma yini oyinika isiphazamisi, ingayithumela lapho.

Londoloza idatha kudivayisi yakho
Funda futhi ushintshe uhlu lwakho lwezinto okumele uzenze
Le plugin ingafunda wonke umsebenzi ohlwini lwezinto okufanele zenziwe zekhibhodi, futhi yengeze, imake, ishintshe futhi isuse imisebenzi.
“%1$s” inesenzo esicela umbhalo le nguqulo ye-WM Keyboard engakwazi ukusinika wona.
I-“%1$s” inesenzo esingenalo igama.
“%1$s” yengeza izenzo zombhalo okhethiwe kodwa ayiceli imvume yokuyishintsha.
“%1$s” inkulu kune-%2$d KB.
\"%1$s\" inesenzo okungekho i-id yaso, ephindaphindiwe, noma engekho emthethweni. I-id yesenzo kufika ezinhlamwini ezingama-32 ezincane, izinombolo, imigqa ephakathi kanye nemigqa engezansi.
“%1$s” ineskripthi esingeyona umbhalo we-UTF-8 ovumelekile.
“%2$s” ibala iwebhusayithi le nguquko ye-WM Keyboard engeke yayithengela: “%1$s”. Amawebhusayithi angamagama afana no-api.example.com noma *.example.com.
Le plugin in-id engeyona evumelekile. I-id inobude obungama-3 kuye kwangama-64. I-id ingaqukatha izinhlamvu ezincane, izinombolo, amachashazi, imigqa, kanye nokudwetshelwa.

“%1$s” inefayela lokuhumusha ikhibhodi engenakuyifunda: %2$s. Ifayela ngalinye ngaphansi kwe-locales/ kumele libe ilebula yolimi efana ne-bn.json noma i-pt-BR.json, ebambe into ye-JSON yombhalo, okungenani engama-64 KB.
“%1$s” inefayela le nguqulo ye-WM Keyboard engenakulayishwa.
“%1$s” inokulungiselelwa okushoda ukhiye noma ilebula yayo, iphindaphinda ukhiye, noma inohlobo le nguqulo engakwazi ukuludweba.
“%1$s” inegama elingukhiye lethuluzi elingasebenzi. Igama elingukhiye linezinhlamvu ezingezansi ezingafika ku-16 nezinombolo.
“%1$s” inombhalo ongenalutho.
“%1$s” ibhalwe nge-Lua, engabe isasebenza ku-WM Keyboard. Funayo inguqulo yayo ye-Python.
“%1$s” ayinayo ifayela layo lesikripthi (%2$s).
“%1$s” icela ukuxhuma ku-inthanethi kodwa ayibali noma yimaphi amawebhusayithi.
Le plugin idinga inguqulo entsha ye-WM Keyboard.
Le plugin ayinalo igama.

“%1$s” ayinayo iphaneli futhi ayinayo imisebenzi, ngakho akukho lutho okufanele ikwenze.
“%2$s” icela “%1$s”, okungasetshenziswa kuphela ama-plugin abhalelwe i-API 5.
“%1$s” inombhalo omkhulu kune-%2$d KB.

Le nguqulo ye-WM Keyboard ayikwazi imvume ethi \"%1$s\". Uhlelo lokusebenza alukwazi ukukutshela ukuthi yini evunyelwe ukwenziwa ethi \"%2$s\".
